candidates.source_title: set boundaries before shared spending | Subscribe for more #motivation 😊👍
candidates.source_description:
Shared living works best when money rules stay clear. A purchase may seem small to one person but still fall outside another person’s budget. That is why roommates should agree on shared costs before anyone spends money for the group. Ask first, set a limit, and make sure everyone has a chance to say no. Good boundaries do not make someone difficult. They prevent stress, debt, and resentment. Clear communication can save more than money. It can protect the relationship too.

#Roommates #MoneyTip
